authExpired.where: Any screen: error toast or message when the sign-in has expired during a request

unknownError.where: Any screen: fallback text in an error toast when the failure has no message

notSignedIn.where: Settings, musician profile: error toast when saving while signed out

databaseNotReady.where: Settings, musician profile: error toast when the app's database connection is not ready yet

recordingUploadFailed.where: Setlist editor, recording popover: error when an audio recording upload fails

printPrepareNoCanvas.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error under the toolbar when the browser cannot draw the chart for printing
printPrepareNoCanvas.context: '2D canvas' is the browser drawing feature; 'chart' = sheet music.

printPrepareRenderFailed.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when a page could not be drawn for printing

printNoPages.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when the chart file has no pages

printPreviewTitle.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: accessible name of the hidden print frame

printTimedOut.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when preparing the print took too long

printPreviewFailed.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when the print preview could not open

printLoadFailed.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when the chart could not be loaded for printing

untitledSetlist.where: Perform mode: setlist title shown when the setlist has no name

printChartLoadStatus.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when the chart file could not be downloaded

printScoreNotRendered.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when a MusicXML score is still being drawn

printUnsupportedType.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error for a chart kind that cannot be printed

printNoFile.where: Perform mode, Print this chart: error when the row has no chart file
